definitions.gloss: articles of incorporation; company charter; bylaws
definitions.explanation: The foundational legal document of a corporation that sets out its purpose, structure, and rules of governance. Required when establishing a company in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定款|ていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I drafted the company's articles of incorporation.

examples.japanese: {定款|ていかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Amending the articles of incorporation requires a resolution at the shareholders' meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、{公証人|こうしょうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{定款|ていかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{認証|にんしょう}→認証：05909_ninshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: When establishing a company, the articles of incorporation must be certified by a notary.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and business term encountered when establishing or managing a corporation. The {定款|ていかん} is one of the essential documents required for company registration in Japan, along with other filings at the Legal Affairs Bureau.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定款|ていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ (to draft articles of incorporation)
- {定款|ていかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{認証|にんしょう}→認証：05909_ninshou⟧ (certification of articles of incorporation)
- {定款|ていかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ (to amend the articles of incorporation)
- {定款|ていかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写|うつ}し→写し：22466_utsushi⟧ (copy of the articles of incorporation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{規約|きやく}→規約：14184_kiyaku⟧: rules, regulations (for organizations, associations)
- {社則|しゃそく}: company rules (internal regulations)
